name: Torn Pass
summary: Cancel a gym membership in three steps with a savings offer; confirming tears the pass in two
about: Torn Pass is a fair cancel flow for a paid plan. It asks why you are leaving, shows a matching offer with the saving counting up in PKR, then asks for a clear confirm with what you lose. Confirming zips the perforation and tears the stub off the pass, which falls away while a receipt prints. Undo flies the stub back and tapes it on; taking the offer adds a gold SAVER tag instead.
how: Press Cancel membership and pick a reason (arrow keys work too).
Read the offer: Take the offer to save, or No thanks to go on.
Tick the confirm box and press Confirm cancel to tear the pass.
Press Undo, keep my pass to tape it back, or Remove offer to drop a saver price.
